outline:
The goal for this advanced ESL reading and conversation course is to further prepare students to participate successfully in the university courses where English language skills are essential. This course is designed to improve your English in reading, speaking, and listening in particular. Besides the required textbook, comprehensive supplementary teaching materials and aids will also be utilized.
There will be frequent discussions and chances for you to speak up and express yourselves. Please do not be afraid to take part in group discussion—this is a pressure-free and friendly learning environment. All students are encouraged to reach out to your classmates, make friends with them, and learn together—in English!
